segments.text: Creta Electric got another price hike in June 2026 — ₹18.03 to ₹24.70 lakh. Hyundai assumes your society already has three.
Petrol Creta: ₹10.91 lakh to ₹20.11 lakh, twenty-seven variants, three engines. Every one ends as a beige school pickup.
Autocar says all-new Creta lands late 2026 — 4.5 metres, finally hybrid. Current one is already outgoing.
My pick: S(O) 1.5 Petrol, around ₹12.06 lakh — wireless charging, ventilated seats, 10.25-inch screen, six airbags. Everything above adds beige leather.
Creta is the paneer butter masala of Indian SUVs. Every family agrees. Nobody remembers which one they had last.
Current Creta or the all-new one? Subscribe — Nexon's revenge is next.
